name: FinTech Production Guard Policy
description: High-security policy enforcing zero production deletion, mandatory approval for cloud mutations, and PII shielding.

rules.name: Block Database Dropping
rules.description: Hard block on DROP statements in SQL queries

rules.name: Require Confirmation for Cloud Changes
rules.description: All AWS EC2 termination and S3 bucket operations require supervisor token

rules.name: Shield Environment & Key Files
rules.description: Prevents any read or write access to private keys and credentials
